Qabri murankiisu socday saddex sano si loo saxo qalad ka dhacay aasitaanka qof dhintay
Published
Waqtiga akhriska: 4 daqiiqo
Haweeney 69 jir ah oo lagu magacaabo Marie Lane ayaa sheegtay inay ka niyad jabtay qabrigii ay horay u sii iibsatay, kaddib markii si khalad ah qof kale loogu aasay, markii dambena meydkiisa laga soo saaray.
Marie ayaa dhulkaas ka sii qabsatay qabuuraha Deeping St James ee gobolka Lincolnshire, si loogu aaso agagaarka qabuuraha waalidiinteed oo geeriyooday.
Wasaaradda Caddaaladda UK ayaa horraantii sanadkan oggolaatay in meydka ninka sida khaldan loogu aasay halkaa laga soo saaro qabriga, si qaladka loo saxo.
Golaha deegaanka ee kaniisadda Deeping St James ayaa qirtay in qalad dhacay, wuxuuna raalli-gelin ka bixiyay dhibaatada soo gaartay labada qoys ee arrintan saameysay.
Golaha deegaanka ayaa sidoo kale sheegay in Marie Lane dib loogu celiyay dhulkii qabriga ahaa ee ay markii hore sii qabsatay.
Marie Lane ayaa sheegtay inay sannadkii 2013 iibsatay si iyada oo keliya lagu aaso dhul ku yaalla gadaasha qabriga hooyadeed.
Waxay sheegtay in dukumenti ay siisay Golaha Deegaanka Deeping St James, kaas oo BBC-du aragtay, uu caddeynayo xuquuqda ay ku leedahay qabrigaas.
"Waxaan iibsaday meel qabuuraha ka mid ah si aan ugu dhowaado waalidkay," ayay tiri.
Warbixinada qotada dheer iyo wararka BBC Somali oo toos kuugu imanaaya WhatsApp.
Halkaan kaga soo biir
Dhamaadka xayeysiinta
Marie Lane ayaa tiri: "Wax macno ah ma samaynayso in halkan la igu aaso haddii aanan la joogi karin dadka aan jeclahay."
Horraantii 2023 ayay booqatay qabuuraha, halkaas oo ay ku ogaatay in qof kale lagu aasay qabrigii ay iyadu sii qabsatay.
"Meesha ayaan iska taagnaa anigoo aan garanayn waxa aan sameeyo. Nin aanan aqoon ayaa lagu aasay qabrigaygii," ayay tiri.
Waxay sheegtay in ay qaadatay in ka badan saddex sano sidii loo heli lahaa oggolaanshaha meydka ninka looga saarayo qabriga, balse aysan haysan doorasho kale maadaama aysan meel kale oo u dhow qabuuraha waalidkeed ka helin.
Sida uu dhigayo sharciga UK, meydka qof laga soo saarayo qabri ku yaalla dhul aan diin gaar ah loo qoondeyn wuxuu u baahan yahay oggolaanshaha Wasaaradda Caddaaladda. Badanaa waxaa sidoo kale loo baahan yahay oggolaanshaha ehelka qofka dhintay.
Hase yeeshee, wasaaraddu waxay oggolaatay in meydka la soo saaro inkastoo ehelkiisu aysan raalli ka ahayn, iyagoo arrintaas ku diidanaa sababo diimeed iyo mid anshaxeed.
Warqad ay wasaaraddu u dirtay Golaha Kaniisadda Deeping St James ayay ku sheegtay inaysan jirin waddo kale oo dhibaatada lagu xallin karo, sidaas darteedna ay oggolaatay in meydka la raro si loo saxo qaladkii aasitaanka.
BBC-du waxay isku dayday inay la xiriirto qoyska ninka meydkiisa la saaray si ay aragtidooda u hesho, balse kuma guuleysan.
Ninka Marie Lane, Eric Lane oo 77 jir ah, ayaa sheegay in dhammaan tallaabooyinkii loo qaaday xalinta arrintan ay saameyn weyn ku yeesheen xaaskiisa.
Wuxuu sheegay inuu aaminsan yahay in Golaha Deegaanka Deeping St James uusan lahayn nidaam wanaagsan oo lagu diiwaangeliyo qabuuraha, taasoo keeni karta in khaladaad noocan oo kale ahi mar kale dhacaan.
BBC-du waxay golaha weydiisay tallaabooyinka uu qaaday si looga hortago in qaladkan oo kale soo noqdo, balse wax jawaab ah kama aysan helin.
Eric ayaa sheegay in xaaskiisu aysan hadda doonayn inay booqato qabuuraha, isagoo yiri: "Waxyaabo badan oo murugo iyo walaac leh ayaa weli la xiriira goobtaas, mana garanayo inay weligood ka dhammaan doonaan."
Dhankeeda, Marie Lane waxay sheegtay inay u damqanayso qoyska ninka si khaldan loogu aasay qabrigeeda, isla markaana ay fahamsan tahay dhibaatada ay arrintani ku keentay.
"Waxaan jeclaan lahaa inaan la kulmo qoyskA," ayay tiri, iyadoo intaas ku dartay inay marar badan golaha ka codsatay inuu kulankaas soo agaasimo, balse mar kasta loo sheegay inaan la qaban doonin.
Marie Lane ayaa intaas ku dartay inay weli dareento xasillooni darro marka ay booqato qabuuraha, isla markaana iyada iyo qoyskeedu aysan hadda u booqan sidii hore.
Waxay sheegtay in su'aalo badan ay weli jawaab u weyday.
"Arrintani ma ahayn inay qaadato saddex sano si xal loogu helo. Xitaa saddex bilood waa muddo aad u dheer. Ma ahayn inaan dhibaatadan muddada dheer ah u marno sidii loo sixi lahaa qaladkii dhacay," ayay tiri.

Both XRP (CRYPTO: XRP) and Solana (CRYPTO: SOL) trade more than 70% below their all-time highs, fueling an ongoing XRP vs. Solana debate over which coin is more likely to recover by 2028.
XRP trades at $1.01, while Solana trades just under $80. In the last month, XRP has dropped 23.3%, and Solana has lost 23.7%. XRP is 72.3% below its all-time high, and Solana is 72.8% below its own, yet many holders are hopeful for a comeback, as both coins have reached such highs before.
XRP Needs a 261% Gain, and Solana Needs a 268% Gain
XRP reached its all-time high of $3.65 on July 17, 2025, so it needs a 261% increase from its price to hit that level again. On the other hand, Solana peaked at $293 on January 19, 2025, and needs a 268% rally to return to that level.
Solana also trades below its lowest close of the past 30 days, $82 on November 12. Both coins set their 90-day lows on August 16, with XRP at $0.99, 2% below its price, and Solana at $75, 5.7% below.
Market capitalization is a coin’s price multiplied by its circulating supply. XRP’s market cap stands at $64.4 billion, making it the sixth-largest cryptocurrency; at $3.65, with the current supply, it would be about $233 billion. Solana, with a market cap of $47.1 billion, would grow to about $173 billion at its $293 peak.
However, supply dilution complicates these recoveries. Ripple gradually releases XRP from escrow, while Solana issues new coins to stakers who lock up SOL to secure the network. As more coins enter circulation, the same price requires more money than before, a problem an earlier look at whether XRP will ever hit a new all-time high also ran into.
XRP ETF Buyers Have Stopped Adding While Holders Stay Underwater
Spot XRP ETFs, which hold the coin directly, had cumulative net inflows of $1.81 billion on October 29. However, that figure decreased to $1.79 billion by November 12, after outflows of $10.4 million on November 9 and $7.6 million the next day. The funds’ total net assets also fell from $1.57 billion on October 21 to $1.16 billion on November 12.
XRP’s price also needs to start reflecting Ripple’s business activity and use of the XRP Ledger. So far, XRP has dropped 56% over the past year. Santiment’s 365-day MVRV, which compares a coin’s market value with the average price holders paid, shows XRP holders about 10% underwater, raising the chance they sell once prices rise enough to break even.
DTCC Gives Solana a Scheduled Catalyst in 2027
The Depository Trust & Clearing Corporation (DTCC), which settles most U.S. stock trades, plans to bring tokenized securities, stocks or bonds recorded as blockchain tokens, to Solana in 2027. Solana becomes the fifth network on its tokenization roadmap.
Despite this, investors withdrew $1.9 million from U.S. Solana funds on November 12, showing some hesitation about the coin’s near-term future. A look at whether Solana could hit $500 by 2028 also weighed the DTCC launch.
Past Recoveries From Drops This Big Took Years
Solana traded at $240 on November 14, 2021, but it took more than three years to reach a new peak on January 19, 2025. Once the rally started, Solana climbed from $57 in November 2023 to $293, a gain of about 414%.
Similarly, XRP rose from $0.63 in November 2023 to its July 2025 peak, a gain of about 480%. Both coins have made bigger runs before, but those rallies came during broad crypto bull markets. Three scenarios for what XRP could be worth in 2028 show how different starting points change the outcome.
Which Coin Has a Better Chance of Returning to Its All-Time High?
So in the XRP vs Solana comparison, which coin is more likely to return to its peak by 2028? Solana looks more likely, though both coins have a low chance of doing it by then. Solana’s DTCC launch in 2027 gives it a scheduled catalyst, but it first needs to recover its 50-day average of $105, 32% above its price, and then surpass its one-year closing high of $147, 85% above.
XRP needs to climb back above its 50-day average of $1.34, 32.7% above its price, with ETF cumulative inflows above $1.81 billion. Without those, XRP risks retesting its August low of $0.99, and if Solana’s DTCC launch fails to draw much trading volume, SOL could slide back to its $75 August low. title: From December 5, businesses may be prohibited from operating during a yellow alert: The Cabinet of Ministers is preparing a postponement until April and June, but not for everyone - Судово-юридична газета

3 min
Businesses without shelters may be restricted from operating during air raid alerts starting December 5: the government is working on extending the transition period until April 4, and for certain enterprises — until June 4.
Businesses that do not have shelters or safe spaces may be prohibited from operating during a yellow air raid alert starting December 5. The government proposes to extend the transition period for businesses until April 4, and for certain facilities — until June 4, 2027. However, not everyone will receive a postponement: businesses must document that they began arranging protection before December 4. Moreover, the draft explicitly grants employees the right to refuse dangerous work, and a temporary protected space will not be considered a full substitute for a shelter. What exactly is the Cabinet of Ministers preparing and who will be responsible for people’s safety?
The Ministry of Economy has prepared a draft amendment to Cabinet of Ministers of Ukraine resolutions No. 1092 and No. 138, which regulate the operation of enterprises during air raid alerts and the use of civil protection shelters.
The comparative table for the draft confirms that the government proposes not just to extend the deadlines for arranging shelters, but to establish new conditions under which enterprises can operate during a yellow threat level.
The main innovation is that the right to defer will depend on real and documented actions by the business. Enterprises that have not ensured protection for people and have not started relevant measures by December 4 may lose the ability to continue working during the yellow alert level.
At the same time, this is still a draft, not current rules. For the proposed changes to take effect, they must be approved by the Cabinet of Ministers and officially published.
Shelters until April 4 and June 4: who the government wants to extend deadlines for
Cabinet Resolution No. 1092 provided a three-month transition period for enterprises without shelters. Initially, it ends on December 4, 2026.
After appeals from businesses, the government announced preparation of changes to give entrepreneurs additional time.
According to the provided comparative table, two main deadlines are proposed.
Until April 4, 2027, enterprises that have documented the actual start of measures to ensure access to shelters or arrange safe spaces by December 4, 2026, inclusive, will be able to temporarily continue operating during the yellow threat level.
Until June 4, 2027, an extension is foreseen for enterprises that are constructing or reconstructing protective structures or dual-purpose facilities that require project documentation and compliance with legal procedures.
But there is a condition: continuation of work will only be possible if the project’s requirements regarding protection of people are met.
In other words, businesses are not offered unconditional permission to operate until spring or summer 2027. This concerns a transitional regime for those already taking concrete measures.
Meanwhile, the March 4, 2027 date previously mentioned by the Cabinet relates to the collection of information by military administrations about enterprises’ compliance with requirements. It should not be confused with deadlines for completing shelter arrangements.
From December 5, not everyone will be able to work during alerts
The strictest provision of the draft concerns enterprises that do not have shelters and cannot confirm that they have started arranging them.
The proposed version explicitly states: business entities that as of December 4, 2026, have not provided shelters or safe spaces and have not confirmed the start of relevant measures, from December 5 cannot operate during the yellow threat level until the established requirements are met.
This is not a general ban on economic activity nor a requirement to close the enterprise permanently. It concerns specifically the ability to continue working during a yellow air raid alert.
However, for shops, cafes, shopping centers, and other establishments whose activities depend on constant visitor intake, such a norm may have significant economic consequences.
An enterprise that has not yet arranged a shelter but has documented the start of relevant work will have a chance to use the postponement. Businesses that have done nothing will not.
Promises alone are not enough: which documents will save businesses from restrictions
The draft clearly defines how enterprises can confirm the actual start of shelter arrangements.
Possible evidence includes:
- Decisions by the business entity to carry out relevant measures with confirmation of their commencement;
- Documents on technical inspections, assessments of premises, development of technical solutions or project documentation;
- Contracts, orders, payment documents regarding purchase, manufacture, supply, or installation of shelters;
- Documents on preparatory, installation, construction works or reconstruction;
- Confirmation of measures to organize access to already existing protective structures;
- Documents on interaction with owners or custodians of premises or shelters.
The list is not exhaustive.
At the same time, the important factor is not the date of formal document signing, but the ability to confirm specific actions taken before December 4.
One of the most important legal novelties concerns labor rights.
The draft provides that approval to continue work during the yellow threat level will be formalized by a protocol of the general meeting of the labor collective or by written consent of employees involved in the work.
Employees must be informed in advance about existing risks, available shelters, and procedures during air raid alerts.
However, even the consent of the labor collective does not mean the employer has the right to force each employee to continue working under any circumstances.
The draft specifically emphasizes Article 6 of the Law of Ukraine "On Labor Protection." According to it, an employee has the right to refuse assigned work if a production situation arises that is dangerous to their life or health or to people around them, with immediate notification of the direct supervisor or employer.
The employer has no right to force the employee to continue such work.
Thus, the labor collective meeting protocol cannot replace individual labor rights. Moreover, the draft explicitly states that agreement with the collective does not exempt the employer from obligations regarding labor protection and people’s safety.
Two walls instead of a shelter: what the State Emergency Service allows and why it may be insufficient
Alongside preparing regulatory changes, the State Emergency Service (SES) published methodological recommendations on arranging safe spaces.
These can be internal rooms of existing buildings capable of reducing the risk of injury from blast waves and debris.
The service recommends choosing rooms separated from the outside environment by at least two walls, preferably in basements or ground floors.
However, the two-wall rule does not automatically mean the room is suitable.
To assess protective properties, the actual condition of structures, wall and ceiling strength, possible blast wave penetration paths, risk of debris formation, and exit blockages must be considered.
The methodological recommendations include technical guidelines such as:
- Thickness of brick or stone external walls — from 56 cm;
- Internal volume — at least 1.5 cubic meters per person;

অসমৰ গোলাঘাট জিলাত সংঘটিত দুৰ্ঘটনাত হোৱা প্ৰাণহানিত মৰ্মাহত হৈছো। এই শোকৰ মুহূৰ্তত শোকসন্তপ্ত পৰিয়ালবৰ্গলৈ সমবেদনা জ্ঞাপন কৰিছো। আহতসকলৰ আশু আৰোগ্য কামনা কৰিছো।

प्रधानमंत्री कार्यालय (PMO) ने पीएम मोदी के हवाले से सोशल मीडिया हैंडल एक्स पर पोस्ट किया, ‘असम के गोलाघाट जिले में हुए हादसे में हुई लोगों की मौत से गहरा दुःख हुआ। इस दुःख की घड़ी में मैं पीड़ित परिवारों के प्रति संवेदना प्रकट करता हूं। घायल लोगों के शीघ्र स्वास्थ्य लाभ की प्रार्थना करता हूं। हादसे में जान गंवाने वालों के परिजनों को पीएमएनआरएफ से दो लाख रुपये की अनुग्रह राशि दी जाएगी। घायलों को 50,000 रुपये दिए जाएंगे।’
गौरतलब है कि शुक्रवार को दिन में असम के काजीरंगा इलाके में रंगाजन के पास एक तेज रफ्तार ट्रैवलर (मिनी बस) ने ट्रक को सामने से टक्कर मार दी, जो बोकाखाट से नागांव की ओर जा रही थी। हादसे में 26 लोगों की मौत हो गई जबकि कई अन्य घायल हो गए। मृतकों में ज्यादातर छात्र थे। टक्कर इतनी तेज थी कि मिनी बस बुरी तरह क्षतिग्रस्त हो गई और कई लोग अंदर फंस गए।
